releases.notes:
## Welcome to Angler's Odyssey

A cozy fishing-collection adventure for Minecraft 1.20.1. Explore habitats, discover 151 fish, chase shiny variants, land trophy catches, and unlock four custom rods as your collection grows.

### Included
- Biome-aware fishing across rivers, lakes, oceans, and more
- Angler's Journal with fish records, statistics, and rod progression
- Four tiered rods with custom fishing bonuses and vanilla enchantment support
- Shiny variants, trophy catches, personal records, recipes, and advancements

### Install
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.20.1.
2. Install Fabric API for Minecraft 1.20.1.
3. Drop nglers-odyssey-1.0.0.jar into your mods folder.

See the [README](https://github.com/grubbs-dev/anglers-odyssey#readme) for controls, progression thresholds, and screenshots.
